definition: A temporary state in which something is not being dealt with.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: Jaggers being highly dictatorial, and Wemmick obstinately justifying himself whenever there was the smallest point in abeyance for a moment.
example_sentence: The building plans are in abeyance until the funding arrives.
